**Finding: compliant (at fallback) — no redline proposed.**

- **Minimum commitment exists but is bounded.** Section 5(a) (p0045) requires fees "not less than $____ per month" for Hosting and Support Services, so we fall short of the preferred "usage/ordered services only" position.
- **Term is one year, not multi-year.** Section 13 (p0078) runs for one year and renews annually only if neither party gives 30 days' non-renewal notice.
- **Exit right is present.** Section 14 (p0079) lets Client terminate at will by written notice, with service (and therefore fees) ending on the last day of the month following notice — roughly a 30–60 day exit, satisfying the fallback's "reducible on 30 days' notice."
- **No penalty mechanics.** No shortfall charge, take-or-pay language, discount clawback, or volume cap on Client usage appears anywhere in the document.

Noted in the rationale but not flagged as deviations: the minimum dollar amounts are left blank, the "Section 4" cross-references in p0047 and p0079 appear mis-numbered (they point to the compensation section), and "Subject to Section 4" in Section 14 could arguably preserve minimums through the notice period. These are drafting clean-ups worth raising in negotiation rather than material fallback failures.
